globalConclusion.colorClassOnlyExtensionDefinition: augment the thirteen generator-5 characteristic columns by vectors indexed only by color class, with zero added voltage on generators 0,...,4 and 6
globalConclusion.reason: all 300 projected side walls have an explicit color-triangle parity conflict

nonClaims: This does not obstruct a facet-specific wall-orientation cover.

This does not obstruct an extension which also gives side generators new color-dependent voltage.

parityArgument.commonGermJustification: all three edges have the same projective reflection root; conjugating their local half-octagon transports to one wall germ adds connecting-path voltage twice and connecting-path parity twice, so both cancel mod two
parityArgument.contradiction: the same oriented wall germ returns with unchanged sheet state and opposite sign
parityArgument.octagonEquation: a side-wall coorientation transported through the (4,5) half-octagon over X edge {a,b} reverses sign and gains sheet voltage lambda(a)+lambda(b)
parityArgument.oddCycleEquation: around color triangle a-b-c-a, the three voltages XOR to zero for every color-class-only lift, while three sign reversals have parity one

projectedSideWallAudit.wallClassRule: canonical projective line of b-a in F5^5; b-a has norm four and its finite-field orthogonal reflection exchanges a and b

type5MinimalColorClassExtension.appendedRowRule: standard basis rows on color classes 0,1,2,3
type5MinimalColorClassExtension.lowerBoundReason: two-sided type-5 walls require each lifted color column to lie outside the span of the other twelve; hence all thirteen columns must be independent
type5MinimalColorClassExtension.scope: minimal among extensions which augment only the thirteen generator-5 characteristic columns, leave the Q action and generator-0,...,4 voltages unchanged, and give generator 6 no new coordinate
